tools.name: prepare_benchmark
tools.description: Prepare a durable DecisionLab benchmark from a folder's dataset.jsonl. Use first to validate data, inspect estimates, and create the review packet.

tools.name: list_benchmarks
tools.description: List durable benchmark workflows and their current stages. Use to find workflow ids or see all pending work.

tools.name: get_benchmark_status
tools.description: Return one benchmark's stage, estimates, review progress, active run, blocker, and next action. Use before every advance.

tools.name: advance_benchmark
tools.description: Advance one workflow by at most one live provider run. Use only after reviewing estimates; first use requires both explicit confirmations.

tools.name: cancel_benchmark
tools.description: Cancel the active run and preserve completed benchmark evidence. Use when the operator explicitly wants the workflow stopped.

tools.name: get_benchmark_report
tools.description: Return the completed default and production-tuned verdicts, confidence intervals, KPI tables, and short Markdown report.
